newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Maxim cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Maxim cut to sell.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it downgraded Maxim Group Inc to sell from buy.
-- Maxim said late Thursday it expects earnings for the first quarter to fall short of analysts' consensus estimate by $0.03 to $0.04 per share.
-- "This comes only two and a half weeks after assuring investors that business is tracking on plan," Interstate/Johnson Lane said in a report.

-- "In our view, this is a company where there is no visibility because this is now the third time management has negatively surprised investors in the relatively brief period we have followed the company," the firm added.
-- The stock was down two points to nine.
